chunks: And with this chain of narration, from Salih ibn Uqba, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

"Nothing among the forms of praise is superior to the Tasbih of Fatimah (peace be upon her) by which Allah is worshipped. And if there were anything superior to it, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) would have granted it to Fatimah (peace be upon her)."

key_terms.لَنَحَلَهُ: He would have granted/given it as a gift

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the Tasbih of Fatimah in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: Imam Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) establishes the Tasbih of Fatimah as the pinnacle of dhikr, asserting its supremacy by noting that the Prophet Muhammad would have granted any superior form of praise to her. This narration, found in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, underscores the unique spiritual status of Sayyida Fatimah (peace be upon her) within Shia tradition, linking her devotional practice directly to the Prophet’s authority and love.
